D: Three men in their thirties start a fraternity at the house next to a college campus.
P: Serve the mains when Mitch's house party kicks off.
S: Frat party smash sliders in paper
the first big party at Mitch's house

Thin crispy smashed beef patties with melted American cheese, pickles, diced onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, wrapped in paper. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for sauce. Heat a griddle until smoking, smash the balls thin, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and top with half a slice of American cheese. Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patty, sauce, pickles and finely diced onion. Wrap each in a square of baking paper.
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce with melted butter and honey, blue cheese dip and celery.
Jalapeños halved and seeded, filled with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon crisps.
M: Brisket rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, smoked or roasted wrapped at 140C for 8 hours until it wobbles, rested an hour, sliced thick. Pickles, white bread and barbecue sauce.
Frank's wedding chicken with mushroom sauce

Chicken breasts pan-roasted in butter and thyme with a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, buttery mash and green beans. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in 30g butter for 4 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 10 minutes and rest. In the same pan fry 300g sliced mushrooms and a chopped shallot, add 125ml white wine and reduce, then 200ml cream and thyme and simmer 3 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Slice the chicken and spoon over the sauce.
W: Chocolate sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fudge frosting and sprinkles, cut into big squares straight from the tray.
K: the keg party at Mitch's house

Bourbon, fresh lemon juice, peach nectar and cold lager stirred in a big bowl with ice, lemon wheels and mint, ladled into red plastic cups. In a big bowl stir 200ml bourbon, the juice of 4 lemons, 60ml sugar syrup and 500ml peach nectar. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml cold lager. Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.

s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings in the fridge overnight. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 80ml hot sauce and 1 tbsp honey and toss. Mix 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream to dip. Serve with celery sticks.

Halve and seed 12 jalapeños. Mix 150g cream cheese with 60g grated cheddar and fill each half. Wrap in half a rasher of bacon, 12 rashers in total, and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

m.how: Rub a 2kg brisket with 2 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Wrap and cook at 140C for 8 hours until it wobbles. Rest an hour and slice thick. Serve with white bread, pickles and barbecue sauce.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.
